card.summary: 20 GB per attached video (official FAQ post: 'Вы можете прикреплять к постам видео размером до 20 ГБ'). Community reports the effective limit was cut to 1 GB...

free_tier.stated: 20 GB per attached video (official FAQ post: 'Вы можете прикреплять к постам видео размером до 20 ГБ'). Community reports the effective limit was cut to 1 GB at one point (2025-07 post: 'Бусти ограничили ... до 1 ГИГА').

record.interface_detail: Web + a reverse-engineered API (community downloaders exist: ath31st/boosty_downloader).
record.chaining: 20 GB is attractive but only for video, and video is transcoded. So the ingest number does not translate into storage of arbitrary bytes.
record.limits_note: Per-object cap is 20 GB for video files. Uploaded video is re-encoded for the internal player rather than served in original bit-exact format.
record.reliability_note: Re-encodes video at ingest and does not preserve original binary files. Published upload limits have been reduced in past platform updates.
